title: Honest comparisons with CoreView, CIPP, Zylo, Torii and other license tools
summary: The new Compare section lines LicenseMeter up against seven other products and five roundups, including the best Microsoft 365 and open-source license tools and how to find unused Copilot licenses. Every page says where the other tool is the better choice, links a source for each claim, and is available in English and German.
